title: Bilingual ANVISA Regulatory RAG Prototype
description: Evidence-completeness and repository-organization patch. One current submission package is clearly separated from archived reviewer snapshots. Restores previously omitted DR11 individual answers and judge assessments, frozen inputs, sibling-context human ratings and selected evidence, and original Howard review returns. Scientific documents, figures, results and human ratings remain unchanged. No new model calls. Current-law accuracy, independent external validation and human workflow benefit remain unestablished. Earlier releases and exact scientific snapshots remain preserved.
